name: CI Ping
author: Pedro S. Oliveira
description: Pings you on screen when CI starts, passes or fails on any of your open pull requests, in every repo and organization. Finds your PRs by itself through the GitHub CLI: no token, no repo list.

barWidget.description: Your open pull requests and their CI in the bar

schema.label: Pings on screen
schema.description: Off keeps CI Ping quiet: follow your pull requests in the panel instead. The bell at the top of the panel flips it too.

schema.label: Check every (seconds)
schema.description: How often to ask GitHub about your pull requests. Lower means faster pings.

schema.label: Ping when CI starts
schema.description: Off keeps only the passed and failed pings.
